review: The candidate boundary is narrow and fail closed. Qualification does not infer production runtime quality from package existence, does not install the candidate as a Terrain Lab runtime dependency, and does not advance TQP-52.
downstream_impact: The production-addon repository is now the pinned TQP-51 candidate. TQP-52 may qualify its public runtime and profile behavior against the retained terrain authority; integration and release work remain blocked.
